objective: Authoritative machine-readable governance for multi-criteria anomaly fusion, detector evidence semantics, deterministic normalization, two-threshold decision policy, and calibration honesty.

data_governance.synthetic_disclosure: Benchmark results and models are based on synthetic semiconductor simulation data. Results do not guarantee external real-world silicon qualification until independently validated on physical fab lot telemetry.

dynamic_weight_renormalization.description: When a subset of detectors is available, active weights are re-normalized to sum to 1.0 across available detectors only.
dynamic_weight_renormalization.formula: w_i_active = w_i / sum(w_j for j in available_detectors)

decision_rules.REJECT: weighted_fusion_score >= reject_threshold OR any individual detector status is REJECT
decision_rules.MONITOR: weighted_fusion_score >= monitor_threshold OR any individual detector status is MONITOR
decision_rules.PASS: weighted_fusion_score < monitor_threshold AND all individual detector statuses are PASS

zero_detectors_available_policy.description: If zero anomaly detectors are configured or available, the engine must NEVER emit PASS. It returns an explicit INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE state.

PASS.definition: Anomaly evidence across all available detectors is below the project-defined monitoring screening threshold.

MONITOR.definition: Anomaly evidence exceeds the monitoring threshold but remains below the rejection threshold. Component is flagged for parametric observation.

REJECT.definition: Anomaly evidence crosses the project-defined screening rejection threshold. Does not prove physical destructive failure, but triggers screening quarantine.

INSUFFICIENT_REFERENCE.definition: Lot sample size is insufficient or degenerate; evaluation proceeds strictly via governed global reference fallback.

UNKNOWN_LOT.definition: Lot identifier was not present in training reference store; evaluation proceeds strictly via governed global baseline.

INVALID_INPUT.definition: Payload violates schema, feature ordering, or contains non-numeric / non-finite values. Triggers immediate exception rejection.

INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.definition: Zero detectors available or active; sample cannot be evaluated.
